shape.situation_pattern: A body of objects (files/tools/laws) each has identity and could be debated.
shape.decision: Treat each object as a dispatchable board thread; no OOP clone, just point at the file and debate/promote/kill.
shape.reasoning_physics: Object identity already exists (id/class/state/messages). Instantiating 138 objects at once is congestion—only N objects live where N doors open.
